title: 黄仁勋称英伟达已实现AGI，旋即又言其“无意义”
summary: 在英伟达周三的财报电话会议上，CEO黄仁勋随口宣布公司已“实现AGI”（通用人工智能），这是科技行业多年来众多巨头追逐的终极目标之一。然而，他几乎立刻又贬低这一里程碑为“无意义”。他的这一说法是正确的。对于支持这一论断的背景而言，黄仁勋的言论反映了当前AI领域对AGI定义的模糊性以及实际进展与炒作之间的差距。尽管英伟达在AI芯片和算力基础设施上占据主导地位，其GPU为当前大模型训练提供了核心动力，但“实现AGI”的说法更多是营销或哲学层面的表述，而非技术上的严格突破。黄仁勋随后解释，AGI的定义取决于标准，若以“通过人类测试”为基准，或许已接近，但若要求“多任务自适应学习”等更高标准，则远未达成。他同时强调，英伟达的贡献在于提供计算平台，而非直接开发AGI算法。这一事件凸显了业界对AGI概念的滥用，以及技术领袖在财报电话会上为提振信心而使用夸张措辞的倾向。实际的技术价值在于，英伟达的硬件持续推动AI能力边界，但AGI本身仍是一个开放且充满争议的目标。
summary_en: During Nvidia's earnings call on Wednesday, CEO Jensen Huang casually announced that the company had 'achieved AGI,' one of the tech industry's ultimate goals that major players have pursued for years. Almost immediately, he dismissed this coveted milestone as 'senseless,' and he is right. Huang's remarks reflect the ambiguity in defining AGI and the gap between hype and actual progress. While Nvidia dominates AI chips and infrastructure, powering large model training, the claim of 'achieving AGI' is more marketing or philosophical than a strict technical breakthrough. Huang later clarified that AGI depends on the benchmark—if it means passing human tests, it may be near, but if it requires higher standards like multi-task adaptive learning, it is far from achieved. He emphasized Nvidia's role as a computing platform provider, not an AGI algorithm developer. The event highlights the misuse of the AGI concept and the tendency of tech leaders to use exaggerated language on earnings calls. The real technical value lies in Nvidia's hardware pushing AI capabilities, but AGI itself remains an open and controversial goal.
